name: net_prologue_mansion_axel_trace
description: VUH-2897 diagnostic-only Mansion to Axel boundary trace, following the base Mansion route and native intros unchanged. Dedicated opt-in on both seats; wait for the bounded30s trace footer before cleanup. No combat barrier or pause is applied. No save.

steps.expr: all(log_count('[axel-boundary] configured=1 diagnosticOnly=1', i) == 1 for i in (0, 1))
steps.message: both seats must install the dedicated diagnostic hooks before the route
the rehearsal save must load Twilight Town on both seats

steps.expr: log_count('[prologue] unpinned start', 0) > 0 and log_count('[prologue] unpinned start', 1) > 0
log_count('control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134', 0) > 0 and log_count('control released at=02/13 evt=134 site=tt19-134', 1) > 0
all(len([a for a in actors(i) if a['name']=='P_EX110']) == 2 for i in (0, 1))
steps.message: both seats must hold both Roxases at tt19-134

steps.expr: {'hostDeaths': log_count('[enemysync] host death epoch', 0) - saved['deaths_before'], 'friendApplied': log_count('client: host death netId', 1), 'deathWithoutBinding': log_count('death-without-continuous-binding', 1), 'unmatched': [m['u'] for m in log_matches(r'\[statehash\] role=client .* unmatched=(?P<u>\d+)', 1)][-1:], 'friendClaims': len(log_matches(r'host hit claim .* damage=[1-9]', 0)), 'duskHitsHostLog': len(log_matches(r'\[hit\] .*attacker=M_EX9\d0 .*-> victim=P_EX110', 0)), 'duskHitsFriendLog': len(log_matches(r'\[hit\] .*attacker=M_EX9\d0 .*-> victim=P_EX110', 1)), 'downs': [log_count('[downed] gate intercept', 0), log_count('[downed] gate intercept', 1)], 'revives': [log_count('[downed] revive returned', 0), log_count('[downed] revive returned', 1)], 'fullPartyDown': log_count('[downed] full party down', 0)}

[log_count('[mission-mirror] host end trap=mission_complete', 0), len(log_matches(r'client end like the host file=TT19_MS602\.bar trap=mission_complete arg=\d+ ok=1 path=', 1)) + log_count('client end observed file=TT19_MS602.bar path=native-local replays=0', 1)]
saved['combat']['hostDeaths'] >= 6 and saved['combat']['deathWithoutBinding'] == 0 and saved['combat']['unmatched'][-1:] in ([], ['0'])
steps.message: both waves must die on the host and apply on the friend, with no unbound or unmatched enemy
each seat must deal damage and take a native Dusk hit
exactly one host mission end, followed exactly once
both seats went down at once

steps.expr: all(log_count('[axel-boundary] stop reason=', i) > 0 for i in (0, 1))

all(len(log_matches(r'\[axel-boundary\] stop reason=trace-deadline .*lossObserved=0 missedArms=0 ', i)) == 1 and log_count('[axel-boundary] arm-missed ', i) == 0 and log_count('site=load-task-start ', i) > 0 and log_count('site=load-finalizers-returned ', i) > 0 for i in (0, 1))
steps.message: both traces must include native load start/completion and finish without loss, missed arm, budget or supersession
